title: 第150章 礼物
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

江执屿沉默地看着工作人员急匆匆离去的背影，上面就差写着几个大字：我心里有鬼。

走廊上空空荡荡，除了江执屿以外再没有半个人影。

江执屿耐着性子等在原地，附近很安静，始终没有其他声响。

不知过了多久，走廊拐角突兀传出沉闷的摩擦声。

咚——咯吱。

声音厚重，在寂静的走廊上格外清晰。

江执屿下意识抬眼，看见拐角走出一个身穿黑色节目组工装的男人。

男人个子中等，身形偏瘦，肩膀却强行撑起一块巨大实木木箱。

箱子长宽都超过一米二，原木原色，看着重量极沉。

整条走廊宽度有限，木箱几乎占掉二分之一通路。

男人低着头，呼吸粗重，额头布满冷汗，脚步拖沓缓慢，每一步都走得摇晃。

来人身份不明，意义不明，木箱内容不明，江执屿本能侧身避让，贴紧走廊墙面。

两人距离仅剩半米时，男人看似脚下一滑，身体瞬间不受控制向江执屿这一侧歪斜。

巨大木箱重心偏移，朝着江执屿这个方向倾倒。

千钧一发之际，江执屿条件反射抬手，绷紧手臂，稳稳托住木箱侧面。

入手的触感让他不由得一愣，手下的木箱一点都没有外表看似的沉重，反而显得有些轻飘，手心和木箱接触时感受到的更像是泡沫箱的触感。

男人转眼间将箱子轻轻放到地上，随即呼出一口气，像是如释重负。

江执屿佩服地看着眼前勤勤恳恳爱岗敬业不管怎么样都要把表演完整结束的男人，语气笃定：“隐藏摄像机。”

男人表情肉眼可见一僵，瞳孔震动，眼中闪过“我去他怎么知道”的震惊。

随即，男人直起腰背，大口喘了两口粗气，原本紧绷的神色瞬间褪去。

他左右快速扫视一遍空旷走廊，确认没有监控死角之外的路人，凑到江执屿耳边，语气神秘兮兮，刻意压低声线：

“恭喜你，江执屿，你成功触发节目隐藏随机神秘任务。”

见江执屿神情淡淡地点点头，男人苦笑一声，决定直接进入正题。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Jiang Zhiyu looked silently at the staff's backs as they hurried away. There were just a few big words written on them: There is something wrong in my heart.

The corridor was empty, with no one around except Jiang Zhiyu.

Jiang Zhiyu waited patiently where he was. It was very quiet nearby and there was no other sound.

After an unknown amount of time, a dull friction sound suddenly came from the corner of the corridor.

Thump - creak.

The sound was thick and clear in the silent corridor.

Jiang Zhiyu subconsciously raised his eyes and saw a man wearing black program crew uniforms walking out of the corner.

The man is of medium height and thin, but his shoulders are forcibly holding up a huge solid wooden box.

The length and width of the box are over one meter. It is made of original wood and looks extremely heavy.

The width of the entire corridor is limited, and the wooden boxes take up almost half of the passage.

The man lowered his head, breathing heavily, and his forehead was covered with cold sweat. His steps were slow and slow, shaking with every step.

The identity of the visitor was unknown, the meaning of the visitor was unknown, and the contents of the wooden box were unknown. Jiang Zhiyu instinctively turned sideways to avoid it and pressed against the wall of the corridor.

When the distance between the two was only half a meter, the man's foot seemed to slip, and his body instantly tilted uncontrollably to Jiang Zhiyu's side.

The center of gravity of the huge wooden box shifted and tipped in the direction of Jiang Zhiyu.

At the critical moment, Jiang Zhiyu raised his hand reflexively, tightened his arm, and firmly held the side of the wooden box.

He couldn't help but be startled by the touch of it. The wooden box under his hand was not as heavy as it seemed on the outside, but seemed a little light. When the palm of his hand came into contact with the wooden box, he felt more like a foam box.

In the blink of an eye, the man gently placed the box on the ground, and then exhaled, as if he was relieved.

Jiang Zhiyu looked with admiration at the man in front of him who was diligent, dedicated and determined to complete the performance no matter what, and said with determination: "Hidden camera."

The man's expression froze to the naked eye, his pupils vibrated, and the shock of "How could he know" flashed in his eyes.

Immediately, the man straightened his back, took two deep breaths, and his original tense expression instantly faded away.

He quickly scanned the empty corridor left and right to confirm that there were no passers-by outside the blind spot, then he leaned into Jiang Zhiyu's ear and spoke in a mysterious tone, deliberately lowering his voice:

"Congratulations, Jiang Zhiyu, you successfully triggered the program's hidden random mysterious mission."

Seeing Jiang Zhiyu nodding calmly, the man smiled bitterly and decided to get straight to the point.
